guarantee.sentence: Shiryaev-Roberts mixture e-detector (Shin-Ramdas-Rinaldo 2022 Thm 2.4): E_inf[N*] >= 1/alpha_arl at alpha_arl = 1e-3 for every conditionally mean-zero sub-Gaussian(1) pre-change law after AR(1) whitening at oracle or estimated (m >= 30) parameters, phi <= 0.9, any changepoint. Heavy-tailed pre-change laws (N5, N6, N8) are NOT claimed. Delay after a K1 canonical step is at most D*(alpha_arl, delta_eff) (Thm 4.3 + Prop. B.2 at the effective whitened shift), registered as a floor and not claimed as a theorem about the increment mixture (Amendment v1.C69).

quantifiers.text: every sub-Gaussian(1) pre-change law in the claimed regime, any changepoint
delay under D* at every phi <= 0.9

regime.nulls: iid-gaussian, ar1-gaussian (phi <= 0.9), estimated moments and phi

shipped_path.kind: e-detector (SR mixture of increments over 16 lambdas), AR(1) pre-whitened, alarm at M_t >= 1/alpha_arl; exported through ./detectors/*, NO shipped compile path (no engine surface dispatches this detector, so S1 is MISSING by construction and the USE, if issued, is USE under the scorer's non-blocking reading of S1)
shipped_path.notes: ADR 0029: ValidityEnvelope.statistic 'e-detector'; assertValidForFdrPath refuses it under every assertion. alpha_arl is delivered by a log(1/alpha) threshold inside the module, not by a bootstrap. The increment is an e-process only for sub-Gaussian(1) residuals: on t3 the ARL was a fifth of the claim (stats/e-sr-delay-2026-09-03).

falsifier: an in-regime S2 cell with arl0_T + 1.645*arl0_se < 1/alpha_arl, or an in-regime K1-canonical delay cell with delay_canonical + 1.645*delay_se > D*(alpha_arl, delta_eff)
